_how_to_edit: Each row is one price, rule or number shown on the site. To update one: change 'value' (and 'note' if needed), set 'checked' to today's date as YEAR-MONTH-DAY, and save. Leave 'id' alone. 'kind' is 'official' when read on the official page, 'secondary' when read on a travel guide.
